## Problem and change

What concrete issue does this solve? Link the related issue and explain what changes for a player or contributor.

## Evidence

For architecture: reference links, dates, coordinate/scale notes and comparable before/after views. For data: provenance and reason for the change. State any remaining estimates.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Mention checks you could not run. Do not treat code tests as visual or multiplayer approval.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change has a focused scope.
- [ ] Coordinate units, source IDs and relevant attribution are preserved.
- [ ] Comments and documentation explain new assumptions or formats.
- [ ] No account data, secrets, game binaries or unrelated saves are included.
- [ ] Runtime limitations and unresolved review items remain explicit.
